YOUR BOARD. YOUR CONNECTION.

A little closer.
Without the cable.

Pair your physical board with Slowboard. Your pieces stay on the table. Your connection travels over Wi-Fi.

  1. Set up the board

    Join its setup Wi-Fi using the details supplied with your board, then open 192.168.4.1. Save your home Wi-Fi and connection-service address.

  2. Get a pairing code

    Generate a code on the board’s setup page. Return your phone to home Wi-Fi or mobile data before continuing here.

  3. Make the connection

    Enter that six-digit code. It expires after two minutes and works once.

WIRELESS PAIRING

Need a new code?

While the board is powered on, hold its BOOT button for three seconds. Join the board’s setup Wi-Fi again and generate a code. Do not hold BOOT while powering on.

One initial firmware upload. Wireless play afterwards.
